intent: Swim through offset wall openings, manage currents, and change depth throughout the route. Expert redesign: submerged sluice doors and algae cutters.

sections.name: The flooded entrance
sections.lesson: Swim up to the first opening · down to the next. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The flooded entrance
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The descending lock
sections.lesson: Follow the openings down through the lock. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The descending lock
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: Between the sunken beams
sections.lesson: Reverse depth between the long beams. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
Between the sunken beams
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The bell chamber
sections.lesson: Climb to the bell chamber, then dive to the outlet. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The bell chamber
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: Against the sluice current
sections.lesson: Use the open chamber to steady yourself before each current. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
Against the sluice current
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The last submerged passage
sections.lesson: Follow the lanterns through the final changes in depth. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The last submerged passage
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.
